risks.risk: Wrong console compatibility / mislabeling (seller says 'Ps6' but photos show PS4).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the exact console compatibility printed on the cases (or a photo of the disc label showing PS4) and confirm the exact platform the discs run on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as PS4 games only (and treat any mismatch as unusable for the buyer’s intended console).

risks.risk: Disc condition (scratches) and whether games actually boot.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of 2–3 discs being inserted and running (or a photo of the disc surfaces in good light).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to work (worst case: assume some may be faulty).

risks.risk: Incomplete bundle / missing titles compared to what’s being sold.
risks.proof: Ask for a written list of all titles included (and a photo showing the full stack with titles readable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller/uncertain bundle (worst case: fewer usable titles).

risks.risk: Region lock / account lock issues (less common for discs, but still possible depending on title).
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the disc region/ratings info on the case back and confirm region.
risks.if_unproven: Price as region-uncertain (worst case: assume potential incompatibility).

proof_requests: Confirm the exact console compatibility (PS4 vs anything else) with a clear photo of the PS4 marking on the cases and/or disc labels.
Send a list of all titles included (count and names) with a photo where every spine title is readable.
Provide disc condition proof: close-up photos of disc surfaces (or a short test video showing games launching).
Show the case backs for region/ratings (or any notes) for at least the most expensive/most requested titles.
response.reason: The photos clearly show PS4 game cases, contradicting the seller’s 'Ps6' claim, and the disc condition/working status is not verifiable from the single image. To price safely, we need proof of compatibility and whether the discs are in working condition.
